📖 How to use

  1. Enter the kWh shown on your last meter reading or bill.
  2. Add your per-kWh rate, the fixed monthly charge and any tax.
  3. Read the full bill breakdown instantly.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Where do I find my per-kWh rate?

It is printed on your electricity bill as the energy charge, usually something like $0.12/kWh. Time-of-use plans have different rates for peak and off-peak.

What is the fixed charge?

A flat monthly fee your utility adds regardless of usage, often labeled "service charge" or "supply charge".

Why is my estimate lower than the real bill?

Tiered rates, demand charges, fuel surcharges and time-of-use pricing are not modeled here. This gives a flat-rate estimate.
